description: Search every research-peptide listing (vendor × peptide × size) and rank by USD per mg, price, vendor verification score or size. Filter by lab testing, stock, payment method, where it ships from and more. Returns listings with the vendor verification score, Finnrick rating and lab-test flags, plus facet counts.

min_score.description: Minimum Finnrick rating (0-100, as Finnrick publishes it).

min_verification.description: Minimum verification score (0-100, computed from checkable evidence; see get_rules). Unscored vendors never match.

passed.description: Only vendors that passed a lab test for this peptide.

peptide.description: Peptide slug or name, e.g. "bpc-157", "Tirzepatide", "BPC-157 + TB-500".

q.description: Words to match in the product name, peptide or vendor.

ships_from.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 (US, CN, HK, CA, GB, AU…) or EU.

tested.description: Only vendors with independent lab tests.

text.description: Free text, e.g. "retatrutide lab tested under $1/mg in stock". Parsed into the filters below.

name: search_listings
title: Search Peptide Listings
